name: AIMoCap CLI usable-clip contract
procedure: Bands calibrated 2026-10-01 from the measured post-P2 full-corpus run (n=4 controlled windows; pose1_narrow_hard blocked_data, user slot pending). finite_coverage_min=0.90 sits below the minimum healthy BODY-joint coverage observed (0.964); slide_p95_max_cm_s=120 sits above the maximum healthy-case foot slide observed (93.0, pose1_calm left). Coverage uses BODY-joint GT-backed fraction (accuracy.coverage), not the all-133 triangulation fraction, because the latter conflates face/hand observability with body usability (pose3_legs: tri 0.406 vs body 0.999 with stable feet). Sample is small: bands are honest but provisional in spirit; recalibrate when user footage lands.
